title: Loop bootstrap race: session-bound loop_start is swept dead before first spawn
summary: Finding (2026-06-10): loop_start({session}) registers the loop, but sessionIsLive() in daemon.js only counts running agents or fresh in_progress claims — a brand-new loop has neither, so the first next_action tick's sweepStaleLoops() demotes it ("driving session dead") and the heartbeat sees an empty registry. Workaround: restart the loop in place without a session binding (empty session ⇒ live by definition; loses cooperative-stop, keeps hard token/iteration caps). Proper fix: bootstrap grace window keyed off startedAt/lastProgress before applying the session-dead rule.
